monthly_year1.explanation: 月度表按整月收付款滞后分摊且不含存货占用，年度表按周转天数计算年末应收/应付/存货，所以 12 月末现金与年度表期末现金不同；月度表用于判断现金节奏与最低点，正式口径以年度表为准。

scenario_labels.downside: Downside: volume -15% (Line 1 commissioning slips ~6 months and offtake converts more slowly, R-01/R-02), price -5% (virgin PET at or below €1,000/t and flake imports, R-03), unit cost +4% (feedstock competition as EPR-funded sorting scales, R-04), opex +3%
scenario_labels.upside: Upside: volume +8% (faster Line 2 utilisation as separate collection volumes grow), price +5% (PPWR/EPR demand pull and certified-content premium), unit cost -3% (negative-value feedstock fractions)
